highlights.text: Joined as Frontend Developer and promoted to Senior within a year (Dec 2024).

Lead frontend for forMedia, an AI broadcast monitoring platform tracking 50+ live TV channels for 80+ analysts, with HLS live and archive playback, in-browser clipping and English and Urdu speech-to-text.

Lead frontend for BetaNexus, a GovTech production monitoring system for Pakistan's FBR that overlays AI detections on live camera feeds across 48+ factory sites, with maps, heatmaps and infinite-scroll tables.
Built a reusable component system: URL-synced, timezone-safe date ranges, multi-select filters and dynamic multi-camera forms, all with full dark and light theming.
Designed Django REST Framework endpoints for internal tools and led contract-first API design for the BetaNexus network monitoring module.
Own frontend architecture, code reviews, TypeScript strict-mode quality and delivery, and mentor junior developers.
Built CICO, a multi-branch QR-code attendance system for Islamabad Diagnostic Centre, on a GraphQL (Apollo Client) data layer.
Implemented role-based access with protected routes and separate admin and employee dashboards.
Built a server monitoring dashboard for uptime and downtime status with Redux Toolkit, Material UI, and Recharts.
Delivered features in an Agile/Scrum team.
Built e-commerce and blog websites in React with REST API integration.
Delivered responsive Bootstrap layouts and custom form validation.
